newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Netcare cuations shareholders.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Netcare cuations shareholders.

text.p: South African firm Network Healthcare Holdings Ltd said on Monday that it was involved in talks which could have an impact on its share price.
The firm said shareholders should exercise caution in their dealings in its shares until further details are announced.
On February 5 Netcare said it's subsidiary Sunninghill Property Services had acquired property which was strategically contiguous with its Sunninghill Hospital property.
It said the property would provide the hospital with capacity for expanded medical facilities and hospital support services.
